Name: Frontend checkout form with Stripe Elements
Description: Jordan will build the checkout form using Stripe Elements, styled to match the app's design. It must handle potential errors gracefully, such as invalid card details or insufficient funds. The checkout button should be prominent. Initial integration target: within two weeks.

Name: Update pricing page with new subscription tiers
Description: Jordan will update the pricing page to reflect the three tiers: Basic ($29/month), Pro ($49/month), and Enterprise ($99/month). The page needs a clear feature comparison for each tier, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if a user chooses a different plan later. Initial integration target: within two weeks.

Name: Build user dashboard with subscription management
Description: Jordan will build the user dashboard to include: current plan details and billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, access to invoices and payment history, ability to update payment methods. The dashboard must reflect current subscription status in real-time and notify users of changes such as successful plan upgrades or payment failures. Initial integration target: within two weeks.

Name: Backend Stripe API integration with webhook handlers
Description: Taylor will integrate Stripe's API to handle subscription-related tasks: creating and managing subscriptions, processing successful and failed payments, and managing webhooks. Webhook handlers needed for: invoice.payment_succeeded (confirm payments and activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify users, prompt payment info update, send email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted (update access rights, offer re-subscription). Handlers must be tested thoroughly with test scenarios simulating different events. Initial integration target: within two weeks, followed by one week of testing.

Name: Prepare and share detailed test plan
Description: Taylor will prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests, including the full subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription. The plan will be shared with Jordan and Alex. Testing phase follows the initial two-week integration period and lasts one week, covering all edge cases.

Name: Integrate frontend with backend API and implement user notifications
Description: Jordan will integrate the frontend with Taylor's backend API once the backend is set up. Subscription changes must be reflected in real-time on the dashboard. Jordan will handle user notifications for events such as subscription confirmations and payment errors, including clear instructions for users on how to fix issues like payment failures.

Name: Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers
Description: Taylor will document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to make future maintenance and troubleshooting easier.

Name: Create user documentation and help section/FAQ
Description: The team will create user-facing documentation and a help section or FAQ that covers common issues and questions about subscriptions, including instructions on how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, and handle any issues. This should be ready once everything is live.

Name: Schedule follow-up meeting next week
Description: Alex will set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress and address any issues that come up during the Stripe integration work.
